set system host-name Device.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set system authentication-order radius.explanation: Configure the authentication order of the system.

set system radius-server 10.6.55.55.explanation: Configures a RADIUS server with the specified parameters, such as IP address, port, and shared secret, for network authentication and accounting purposes.

port 1645.explanation: Configures the RADIUS server with `[parameter1]` as the server address and `[parameter2]` as the port number for authentication and accounting communication.

parameters.name: port
parameters.explanation: Port number for the RADIGUS server.

secret \"051B1C224D0A324E1D\".explanation: Configure the IP address, port and shared key of the RADIUS server.

accounting-port 1646.explanation: Configure the billing port for the RADIGUS server.

set system accounting destination radius.template: set system accounting destination radius server [parameter1]
set system accounting destination radius.command: set system accounting destination radius server 10.6.55.55
set system accounting destination radius.explanation: This command configures the Junos device to send accounting data to a specified RADIUS server identified by `[parameter1]` for system accounting purposes.

secret \"051B1C224D0A324E1D\".explanation: Configure the system billing information to be sent to the specified RADIUS server.

parameters.name: secret
parameters.explanation: A shared key to communicating with the RADIGUS server.

set access address-assignment pool pool1.explanation: This command fragment configures an address-assignment pool named `[parameter1]` for dynamic IP address allocation in Junos.

family inet network 10.10.10.0/24.explanation: Configure the network address and subnet mask for the distribution pool.

family inet range user-range low 10.10.1.explanation: The command `family inet range user-range low [parameter2]` specifies the lower bound of an IPv4 address range within a user-defined range configuration.

parameters.name: low
parameters.explanation: Start IPv4 address for user range.

family inet range user-range high 10.10..explanation: The command configures a range of IPv4 addresses (`family inet`) with a specified upper limit (`high [parameter2]`) within the `user-range` for address assignment.

parameters.name: high
parameters.explanation: End IPv4 address for user range.

family inet6 prefix 2001:db8:3::/64.explanation: The command configures an IPv6 address family with a specified prefix (`[parameter2]`) and prefix length (`[parameter3]`) for routing or interface settings.

prefix-length 64.explanation: The command `prefix-length [parameter4]` specifies the subnet mask length for an IP address or route, defining the number of network bits in the prefix.

set access profile radius-access.explanation: This command fragment sets an access profile in Junos, defining a named profile (parameter1) to configure security policies, authentication, or authorization settings for network access.

parameters.name: profile-name
parameters.explanation: Accesses the name of the profile.

authentication-order radius.explanation: Configures the authentication order for access to the profile.

client radius-server 10.6.55.55.explanation: This command configures a RADIUS server as a client under a specified access profile, enabling authentication and authorization for network access.

secret \"051B1C224D0A324E1D\".explanation: Configure access to RADIUS client information for the profile.

parameters.name: secret
parameters.explanation: A shared key to communicating with the RADIGUS server.

unit 0.explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

family inet address 10.1.1.1/24.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: ip-address
